newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures end steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures end steady to higher.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures ended steady to higher in moderate trade on some late local buying interest in line with higher Japanese prices, brokers said on Thursday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked up slightly across the board after being lifted by technical buying.
"The market was untraded in the morning session on a lack of fresh factors. But prices were marked up slightly in the afternoon in sympathy with higher prices in Tokyo and Kobe," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, July RSS3 rose 1.25 cents to 115.75 U.S. cents a kg.
June RSS1 was unchanged from Wednesday's settlement of 163.25 Singapore cents (US$1.14) a kg.
September TSR20 rose one cent to 157.50 Singapore cents (US$1.10) a kg.
